caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden figurine resembling a stylized human or humanoid form. The figure has a roughly carved, polygonal head with simple facial features including two round eye shapes and a small horizontal line for the mouth. The torso is rectangular with two arm-like extensions emerging from either side, bent outward at the elbows, and ending in simplified hands with carved fingers. The chest features a row of four small, dark circular markings that may represent buttons. The lower body tapers into a skirted or broadly rounded shape, with two legs angled outward. Each leg bends at the knee and ends in pointed feet. The figure is uniformly colored in various shades of brown, with darker brown lines and segments accentuating the joints and features. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present in the composition.
title: Carved Wooden Doll
